text:
maya.design: Quick copy check on the 'Disable autoscaling' confirmation modal. Current secondary help link says 'See autoscale behavior' which a11y flagged as vague. Need short, screen-reader-friendly phrasing. tomas.pm: agreed. product concern: we also need to make it explicit if disabling will affect current jobs. Customers keep opening tickets asking if their running jobs will be impacted. indra.eng: technical constraints: theres a short paragraph in the modal body that explains draining behavior. If the link text is short, we can use aria-describedby to attach that paragraph for screen readers. sam.a11y: short link text is fine only if the link is programmatically tied to context. WCAG note: link text should be meaningful out of context. aria-describedby to the explanation paragraph is a good compromise. noah.prod: proposal: we should test two variants: 'Learn more' (compact) vs 'Autoscale behavior' (explicit). Track clicks + subsequent support events. maya.design: my microcopy options: - Short: 'Learn more' (aria-describedby="#autoscale-info") - Mid: 'Autoscale behavior' - Long: 'What happens when you turn off autoscaling' Which do we prefer? I prefer short visually but want to avoid losing clarity for keyboard/screen reader users. indra.eng: implementation snippet if we go short: ```html

Disabling autoscaling freezes the pool size. Running jobs continue; new jobs may queue until you scale manually.

Learn more ``` This keeps UI tidy and gives SR users context. Also suggest placing link after the paragraph and before action buttons. sam.a11y: follow-ups: ensure link has accessible name via aria-describedby, and test with VoiceOver and NVDA. Also ensure focus order doesn't skip the paragraph when tabbing to the link. tomas.pm: product ok with the aria-describedby approach. Also want the primary action to include the pool id on hover/title to prevent accidental clicks: 'Disable autoscaling' as button, title="pool: prod-gpu-02". noah.prod: can we add a one-line inline caution: 'Note: new jobs may queue' under the body? that'll deflect a lot of support tickets. maya.design: will update Figma: modal body will include single-line caution and paragraph with id=autoscale-info. CTA: primary button 'Disable autoscaling' (danger), secondary inline link 'Learn more' with aria-describedby. I'll also add title attr for pool name on the confirm button. Will post mock in #design when done. sam.a11y: thanks 44d please add to accessibility checklist: link text, aria-describedby present, focus order, color contrast for danger button. maya.design: thanks everyone 4aa will iterate and ship copy + figma link.
